towns.name: Shoushi
towns.summary: Shoushi ('small place') is the Sho starter town south of the Blackmire, raised from the torn-down walls of the warlord Ijiku Tambai's fortress Yaosai once the Mosswart raiders were pushed back; it has outgrown its mocking name as the waypoint between Hebian-To and the western Sho holdings, and is home to the Sho casino (Gan-Zo's Den of Iniquity). On flat ground at z 20 the town is a grid of low 2.5 m wall segments and roofed gates - the old Yaosai walls - enclosing green-roofed Sho halls, dome houses and the Spire of Serenity, a 31 m octagon pagoda. At its heart a small walled court with roofed north and south gates holds the Life Stone, a fountain, a well and a flowering tree, with the Town Network portal just outside; a nullified drudge statue on its pedestal and the Three Swords Hall face the plaza ring around it, flame lanterns line every lane, and a five-storey spire tower rises north of the walls.
